integrity: Standalone proof and deterministic verification script included; finite enumeration through q=5 corroborates but is not used to infer all orders.
scientific_limitations: Assumes existence of a projective plane at order q; proves a statement for all such planes by incidence axioms. Results for real-line five-point isomorphism types and VC upper bound were already established by Eleftheriou et al. (2025). The new scope is the finite-plane all-coefficient count and sharp exceptional order three; independent verification has not been conducted.
title: Finite-order exceptions and the shattering polynomial of two-line unions in projective planes
